value.rationale: Canonical weighted-star harmonic replacement has a complete exact stability law in complete-pair Gini variation, although its quadratic Dirichlet energy is minimized. The sharp three-leaf onset of amplification, unique uniform minimax conductances, exactly four-leaf peak 9/8 among uniform designs, and unattained global envelope 2 are natural structural questions relevant to non-Euclidean stability of graph smoothing. The precise norm is sharp and attained for every positive weight vector; no downstream broad theorem is claimed.
